g.title: Service code selects a provider for the requested task.
Read environment and stored integration settings; no credential values appear in the editor.
Caller receives provider-confirmed data or a route-specific service error.
Validation, access, conflict or service errors are returned to the caller. Status and error shape depend on the specific route.
Failure end state. Caller receives the actual error; a retry may be offered by the UI.
Native driver and transactional repository. Hosting on Atlas, cluster layout and live connectivity are Unverified.
Orders, captured payments, signed webhooks and refunds. Credentials, enabled webhook events and merchant connectivity are Unverified.
Sandbox orders, approval, capture and verified webhook. Sandbox endpoint is explicit. Live PayPal settlement and automatic PayPal refunds are Planned.
Serviceability, shipment, pickup, cancellation and tracking. Courier configuration and live operational readiness are Unverified.
Outbound account, order, support and notification email. Sender domain, API configuration and delivered email are Unverified.
State / PKCE and JWKS-verified identity. Enabled provider configuration is Unverified.
Identity verification and client-secret signing. Apple keys, enabled provider and runtime readiness are Unverified.
Search SDK and optional product index synchronization. Index freshness and configured keys are Unverified.
Legacy test-mode checkout and signed webhook. Checkout is guarded to sk_test_ credentials; live checkout is not claimed.
OAuth mailbox connection and sync. Mailbox connection, grants and scheduler execution are Unverified.
HTTP translation provider selection. Provider selection depends on environment; active configuration is Unverified.
Owner copilot with constrained provider endpoint. Provider connectivity and model response quality are Unverified.
Separate realtime support transport. Local support process / deployment transport availability is Unverified.
JSON-RPC tools/call for address, search and route tools. Active token and tool availability are Unverified. A hardcoded fallback token exists in source; its value is excluded from documentation.
Validated public-ID image transformation URL helper. The helper creates CDN URLs. Admin uploads currently write to local public/media/uploads; Cloudinary upload API implementation is not claimed.
INR display-rate HTTP fetch with cache. Rates are approximate display conversions; provider failure returns an empty rate list. Runtime availability is Unverified.
Leaflet browser tile requests for store maps. Public tile rendering is implemented; availability and usage at runtime are Unverified.
Browser deep links to WhatsApp / wa.me. This contact UI opens WhatsApp. It does not prove a server-side automated message-sending API exists.
Stored settings and Graph API identity checks. Credential-check code exists for WhatsApp/Messenger. Automated message delivery and a verified Messenger webhook are not established by these checks.
Measurement-ID storage and format check. Settings UI exists. No gtag/GA collection call was found in src; automatic GA4 event delivery is Planned, not proven by ID validation.

svg.text: Source-based documentation | Dashed edges: proposed | Runtime connectivity: Unverified | Not an executable n8n workflow
